statement: In world 3 take Sheepy and Frostflake first, then Mammoth, then Quenchy. All four maps let you hit every node on the grid.
He finished all his glorifies and isn't sure that was wise; he should maybe have saved for Bargain and is now behind on it.
Bargain is what everybody is racing for right now, and many people are getting it to level 10.
Push Greater Education on nodes where you don't care about extra speed, like the center ones. Push Advanced Logistics on the edge nodes, since it's a true multi on collection rate.
Get Expanded Barracks to level 2 or 3, after which it seems more efficient to invest in Advanced Logistics and Greater Education.
Same approach applies to world 1 but most people care about world 2 and world 3 at this point.

Legend talent red three gives 48 upgrades a day for masterclass and makes masterclasses 80% cheaper; get it rolling before merit week.

Emperor, the world 6 boss, gives extra drops of bones, dust and tachyon as a real multiplier, so getting into it is 100% worth it.
